environment: Pre-release v1.3.19 validation. Direct Foxrouter contract smoke used the supplied upstream credential without recording it: one and two Base64 Data URL strings in Alias.images were accepted with HTTP 200 and task IDs; a single unwrapped string was rejected with HTTP 400, confirming the upstream []string contract. Local binding tests verify the account-specific mapping converts image objects to Data URL strings, preserves one or many images, and leaves other models' array mappings unchanged. No production verification is claimed until the v1.3.19 cutover completes.
